title: FEMA Rules Amended: Overseas Individual Portfolio Investment Limit Raised to 10%
summary: Amends Non-Debt Instruments Rules 2019, doubling individual non-resident holding limits in listed equities.

blocks.content: Amends Non-Debt Instruments Rules 2019, doubling individual non-resident holding limits in listed equities.

items: Individual Holding Cap: Maximum holding for individual overseas investor (PROI) in a listed company raised from 5% to below 10%.
Aggregate Limit: Combined holding of all overseas investors increased from 10% to 24%.
Coverage Expansion: Extends portfolio investment route to all individual Persons Resident Outside India (PROIs) at par with NRIs and OCIs.

blocks.title: Key Details & Regulatory Matrix
rows: Maximum holding for individual overseas investor (PROI) in a listed company raised from 5% to below 10%.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: FEMA (Non-Debt Instruments) Rules 2019 governed by Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Individual PROI cap (below 10%) vs aggregate limit for all non-residents (24%).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "What is the significance of the 2026 FEMA Non-Debt Instruments amendment for foreign retail investors?"
💡 **Model Answer: It doubles individual portfolio investment caps in listed Indian companies from 5% to below 10% and extends NRI/OCI investment privileges to all non-resident individuals.**
